summary: Inno Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Sales Agreement with Aegis Capital Corp. for an at-the-market offering of up to $60 million of common stock. The filing is a routine capital raising mechanism, not a special situation. The ATM facility allows periodic sales at prevailing market prices with a 3% selling commission. No specific terms, premium, or strategic event are involved. The program runs through December 31, 2026 or until all shares are sold. This is a standard equity offering agreement, not a transformative event. Watch for potential dilution but no risk-arb angle.
